title: Forces on the lighter mass of an Atwood machine
caption: The masses accelerate at a = (m₁ − m₂)g / (m₁ + m₂) = 1.96 m s⁻². For the 2.0 kg mass, rising, tension T = 23.5 N exceeds its weight 19.6 N by m₂a = 3.92 N.
